place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Their pastries and drinks here are delicious. It has become one of our go-to cafes in downtown Davao. The service is great as well. Very attentive, and fast. Waiting time is around 5-10 minutes. Their serving portion is generous. I really liked their tocino rice meal. We've also tried their cheeseburger, longganisa, and house-smoked bacon. All of these were delicious.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: I've dined at this café several times, and each visit has been marked by consistently excellent service. The staff are attentive without being intrusive, which makes the experience all the more comfortable. I'm particularly drawn to the interior—its mid-century aesthetic is thoughtfully executed and well-maintained, creating a space that feels both stylish and inviting. In terms of food, the pricing is reasonable and proportionate to the servings. The menu, however, can be somewhat uneven: some dishes are genuinely flavorful, while others could benefit from more seasoning. It's best to ask for their bestsellers to ensure a more reliable experience. That said, the café truly shines in its coffee and pastries—both are well-crafted and consistently satisfying.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: I really had an amazing time here. The food is top notch, from the different pizzas to the burgers, pasta, and other meals, everything was delicious and satisfying. The service was also great and the staff handled everything smoothly. Overall, I really love this place and would definitely come back again.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: I've been here a couple of times already, and it's always a great experience. The ambiance is really nice, the staff are friendly and accommodating, and the food never disappoints. I recommend their signature cheeseburger it's a must-try (quality is bomb) Will definitely come back!

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: What an amazing place. The food and atmosphere was amazing. You must go to this pastry place that also serves delicious food at the right portion to eat. This must be your first stop to eat if you visit Davao. If you dont believe this post then yes I challenge you to find out for yourself and you will see why i was compelled to post my review.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: The staff is very hospitable. The food is also good. Ive tasted a different version of mango sticky rice here compared to what Ive had in Bangkok. I love the ambiance of the place, and the noise level from the surroundings is just right.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Cafe Gervacios is a great place with good food and coffee. The chicken alfredo is one of the best pastas I've had in town. The prices are reasonable, and I'd love to try their other items on the menu. The customer service is good, and the location is also okay and easy to find. I would probably come back here again.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: " love the croissant, coffee, and pasta at Gervacios Cafe, each one is so satisfying and full of flavor. The croissant is perfectly flaky, the coffee is just right, and the pasta is comforting and delicious. Every visit feels cozy and worth it, especially when you find your favorites in one place."

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Hardly noticeable, discreet looking cafe from the street! So glad it's been picked up by Google! Staff- super attentive, accommodating, quick on their feet despite busy time at Sunday brunch-lunch hours Food- good amount of serving, tried their homemade longganisa meal and it did not disappoint. You can have the eggs as you prefer Hot beverage- tried their Earl grey latte, super good! Holiday ornaments also give it a nice touch in their cafe + thoughtful paper placemat 👏🏼

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Great food and service… only con is the space. Atmosphere will be better with more space. And we came with infant - washroom is not friendly to diaper changes.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: the pastry taste great and worth the price for it's quality. I came from a walk decided to or their flamingo drink it's better to drink it as you enjoy the cozy atmosphere in their resto. the staff are accommodating. For me they taste near italian so if you have that tastebuds... it is a must visit.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Great food, nice ambience. While they're located downtown, it doesn't give you that city night vibe. There's not much to do at 10-11 pm (their closing hours) DGT is more lively than downtown.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: TBH, I love everything here. From how the cozy the place is, their staff being attentive, friendly and alert, to the food with exact flavor, taste and quality and the service. I'd love to keep coming back! This cafe deserves more appreciation same as the well known coffee shops. This cafe has quickly become my new favorite!

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: This place is very nice and very cozy. Ive been eyeing to go here for a long time but i thought parking is an issue. Apparently they have a huge parking at the back of the cafe

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: The staff were nice, attentive, and accommodating. The food was not so good. I ordered their longganisa burger with salad on the side, but it wasn't fresh. The place is peaceful and quiet.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: June 2025 — Cafe Gervacio's has been on my radar for a while, and it definitely lives up to the visual hype. I've been curious for three reasons: its high rating, the inviting glass-front interior that looks like a 1950s cinematic set, and the fact that it's almost always packed. After a visit to the National Museum of the Philippines – Davao (which is just a short walk away), I finally caught them at a "sweet spot" around 3:30 PM when seats were available. Almond Croissant - ₱170 is baked to perfection. The top is buttery and flaky, the middle is airy, and the base has that satisfying crunch. It's sliced and filled with a mysterious, delicious cream that elevates the whole experience without being overly sweet. It is easily one of the best croissants in the city. Iced Spanish Latte - ₱170 was a bit of a letdown. Compared to other local specialty shops or even the standard Starbucks version, this felt bland. I was looking for that distinct creamy balance of condensed milk, but it tasted a bit "thin." The ambiance is "Noir-chic" of glossy wood, low ceilings, and a polished aesthetic that feels very classy. The AC is cold and the pipe-in music adds a nice touch, though the acoustics are tricky. Because of the low ceiling, loud conversations tend to echo, so it might not be the quietest spot for deep work unless you're seated right under a speaker to drown out the noise. Service was impressive - attentive, friendly, and my food arrived in under 20 minutes. I also have to mention the comfort rooms; they are separate, aesthetic, and very well-maintained, which is a big plus for me. Outlets are scarce (I only spotted one near the entrance), so come with a full battery. For payments, they accept Cash, Credit Cards, and E-wallets. If you want a peaceful experience, aim for the mid-afternoon (3:00 PM – 4:00 PM) before the dinner crowd rushes in. I'll definitely be back to try their "proper" meals (like the Beef Tapa or Pasta).

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Visited Cafe Gervacios Pastry and Coffee in Davao City and had a wonderful experience! We ordered their salad, pasta, and one of their juice sodas, everything tasted great and was served hot and fresh. The flavors were well-balanced, and you could tell the ingredients were of good quality. The ambiance is cozy, clean, and thoughtfully designed, perfect for catching up with friends, enjoying some quiet time alone, or even getting work done over coffee. Though we didn't get to try their pastries, they looked absolutely tempting and freshly made. The staff were polite, kind, and attentive, which added to the pleasant dining experience. We went on a Wednesday night, and the place wasn't too crowded, a relaxing midweek spot. They're open until 10:00 PM, which is a plus for late coffee runs or casual evening meet-ups. Overall, highly recommended for anyone looking for a chill café spot in Davao. Will definitely come back to try their pastries next time!

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: The interior of the place is very welcoming and chic! Their service was good, even though we came here during their opening day. The staff was very well trained so kudos to them. As for their pastries, we tried the almond croissant among other things and it instantly became my favorite! As for their drinks, I got their sweet nostalgia latte and it tasted great! I can't wait to try their meals! Would recommend!

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Amazing selection of coffees and pastries but I honestly find the pricing too steep. So it can be visited once in a while but not often due to price. We just had the cheesecake eclair (P198 for a 4-5" long eclair), and tablea cookie (around P150) and cafe latte. We visited this during our travel to Davao and honestly one of the best spots we visited during our trip. Can accommodate a lot of people.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: We were a group of 6 and we ordered the Ragu, classic meatball pasta, shrimp aglio olio, fish and chips, smoked bacon 2x. We all enjoyed the food, service as well as the ambiance! To the point that we all tried a different pastry each and fell in love with the Ube Japanese roll. We also really liked the others (Dirty Chocolate Croissant, Mango Sticky Rice, chocolate concord cake, brownie croissant, lemon blueberry muffin) Definitely a must try location. Joshua was a very accommodating server! Focaccia bites and the chicken pesto pizza were a good plus as well.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: We arrived after dinner (around 8 PM), hence, we didn't order any pastas or meals, only pastries/deserts and drinks. I'm rating based on: A. Quality of food and price The food itself was good, we ordered 4 pastries and all of them were delicious. The hot cappuccino and their iced sweet nostalgia was also good, although if you like your coffee sweet, you might want to consider another drink. The prices were slightly pricey for the food. Taste-wise, the chocolate roll and muffin is similar to any other pastry, but the defining feature of their pastries is the crunch, a semi-crunchy muffin and cookie was the best touch. The star of the show was the Ferrero croissant, it was flakey and buttery, and the cream was light yet adds so much flavor. 2. Service We didn't know where to order at first because waiters did not approach us (maybe because it was crowded) so when we checked the pastries up front, the owner (I assume) kindly led us back to our seats and assigned us a waiter. There were a few items that they did not add on our bill, so it got changed last minute (but it was minimal). 3. Space, Decor, and Ambiance The decor was pleasing to the eyes, it felt somewhat like a modern Japanese design mixed with hints of retro wooden furniture, and the dark blue gives off a subtle clean/luxurious feel. Ambiance was good, although towards the end there was a loud group beside our table (I would say this is beyond the control of the staff). The seats near the counter were spacious, the ones near the road, not as much.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: The food is great. The ambiance is perfect. In terms of hospitality, it was amazing. The almond croissant was creamy. However, whip cream on the vanilla frappe tasted like cardboard. Plus, I don't get why they serve my frappe first and took so long to serve my croissant when it doesn't recruired to be microwaved. To sum it up, I'm not going back.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Cafe Gervacios is located downtown, which makes its cafe-style setup a bit unexpected in the middle of the busy area. The place has a pleasant interior and a generally relaxed atmosphere. We ordered the plant-based adobo flakes and longganisa. The adobo flakes were softer than expected. I thought it'd be crispy but it was wet and a little too salty for my taste. The longganisa was okay. Portion sizes for both were generous. What really stood out were the drinks. We had the Himalayan cafe latte and the matcha latte. Both tasted great, definitely the highlight of the meal. However, the pricing felt a bit off, as the drinks were almost as expensive as the main dishes. One thing that could use improvement is the service. There were a lot of staff present, but service was slower than expected. They also have a parking area, which is convenient, but it was muddy during our visit and took away from the overall feel of the place. Paving it would make a big difference. Overall, Cafe Gervacios has potential. The space is aesthetic and the drinks are strong.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: While the aesthetic ambiance is inviting, customer service needs improvement. I went there to have coffee and some pastries, but the waitress wasn't able to explain the difference in the 2 options of flavor in Americano coffee. I asked for WiFi since it's discoverable from my device, but the wait staff just casually said it's not available (with no apology), so I cancelled my orders and decided to leave. But their whole team begged that I have to pay for my coffee since it's been made and they'll share its cost. All of them just highlighted that they will all suffer the burden of dividing the amount, but none of them sincerely apologised and gave a proactive response. So I just paid for my coffee and left. On a positive note, it's the security guard there who showed some respect and courtesy. Management should check on their guest-facing staff and train them on product knowledge, proper customer service and basic guest relations skills.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: I enjoyed every second, every bite, and every sip (of water HAHA). Highly recommended.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Great food and cozy place! Loved the pesto pasta and the pizza, both were really tasty! Cheesecake was a nice finish too. Friendly staff and chill ambiance. Will definitely come back!

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: There are plenty of parking space exclusive for the cafe's customers. As you walk inside, the cafe is very spacious with a lot of chairs. It feels clean and expensive. And it truly is on the expensive side. However, i think their servings are good for sharing. Their apple crisp salad is good. They also have fun pieces so their decorations are funky and i like it.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: We went there on a weekday for dinner, the place was packed with people. It was cold and clean, and has a slight smell of paint(?)/new furniture(?). A bit pricey. We tried their chocolate cheesecake and I loved it. The three cheese pizza was more tomatoey than cheesy. The beef ragu pasta was tasty albeit the pasta was slightly overcooked. We also tried their coffee: sweet nostalgia (I like this) and berry (forgot the specific name). Staff were friendly but their service was a bit unorganized. Took awhile to take our order but they were all standing near the counter, and we almost had to take the menu ourselves. But afterwards, it was flawless. All in all, food quality and service need improvement, but it's a good place to dine!

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Went here after church on Mothers Day and was able to get a table without waiting. We started out with the Spanish Lattes, one hot and one iced, and both were very good. We ordered the Bacon Wrapped Sausage and Pork Adobo. Prices might be a little steep, but the food was very good and service was prompt. The cafe was full when we left and this place will be a local landmark soon for sure. Check it out for yourself!

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Our first time to visit Cafe Gervacios, but we've heard so much about it from friends and in social media. Our curiosity brought us there after having dinner somewhere else. We were truly delighted with our late night experience at the cafe. We came less than an hour before its closing time. But it was enough for us to order coffee, tea and frappe and a few pastries. We were all happy with the service, the ambiance, and of course the food and drinks. Staff were very courteous and attentive. Even the manager/owner was very gracious and hospitable. We loved our sampling of their pastries. We tried the Ube muffin, mango sticky rice, and coffee kouign amann. Very interesting and perfectly paired with our beverages.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Lovely cafe/restaurant, if you want a great restaurant quality experience it is one of the best places to eat at in Davao, possibly in Mindanao. You can appreciate the higher standards, the owners probably travelled the world and appreciate sharing a great culinary experience: - Food: Tasty, big variety and offering uncommon things (🇫🇷🥐, 🇩🇪🌭, 🇮🇹🍝 and homemade 🇵🇭 foods), great drinks also like the homemade cold brew coffee. - Value: Excellent (8'700 PHP for 9 people or 967 PHP per person considering that we had a huge brunch and even took food away) - Service: Welcoming, serviceable and attentive. They are well trained and serve the food quite fast. - Ambiance: Nice decors with xmas tree over xmas period, staff also hat xmas hats. Very clean and spaced tables. Well presented pastries and menu cards. Toilets were relatively clean and well equipped.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: This new coffee spot has it all - great ambiance, tasty food, and amazing coffee! I personally love the salmon tartines, they were so yummy. Their servings are also generous. If you prefer your coffee strong, you will love it here!

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: I had a great experience at Café Gervacios. I ordered the Truffle Parmesan Dauphinoise, and it was really satisfying—rich, creamy, and full of flavor. The food was served in a timely manner, and the atmosphere was pleasant, making it a nice spot to relax. My server, LA, was very polite and attentive, which made the experience even better. I also appreciated that they didn't rush me out—I was able to just hang out and chill for a bit. I also tried their coffee, and it was great! If you're looking for a cozy place with good food, friendly service, and solid coffee, I'd definitely recommend checking it out.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Found a new resto in Davao City and it's a new fave! Cafe Gervacio offers wide selection of menu such like pizza, pasta and pastries, and boy oh boy it's a 5 ⭐️ for me. I will definitely be back and try other food option (there's too many). Also, shout out to Marvin, the proactive staff of Cafe Gervacio.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Excellent service! The staff and crew are impressive — they know their regular customers by name and always make everyone feel welcome. All of them have great attitudes and are genuinely friendly.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: we went there this time for dessert. all their desserts were beautifully made. we ordered matcha tea eclair, chocolate eclair, ferrero, and cookies and cream frappe. matcha te eclair was my favorite. i was pleasantly surprised by the filling. very good! the chocolate eclai was ok. im just not a fan of dark chocolate. the ferrero was a surprise too. they call it ferrero croissant but it looked more like a cupcake. when i sliced it up, it was the same flaky texture of a croissant. it lacked a bit of flavor though. it had no oomph! cookies and cream frappe needed more cookies. but otherwise, i would still come back to the place. lots of food choices. the ambiance was nice and the temp cool.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: My favourite spot for a hot matcha latte, especially because they offer oat milk as a substitute. Their breakfast meals are on point, and the adobo is absolutely delicious. The ambiance is great, and the service is amazing and attentive. Plenty of payment options and even parking available—what more could you ask for?

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: The place is good. Not crowded when I went just very recently. Staff were nice. CR is clean. Interiors are great for a cosy coffee or meal alone or with family and friends. The food is good and aesthetic. Maybe I should try pasta or meal next time.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Our most favourite restaurant in Davao. In my opinion, it could pass European standards 💯. We went for brunch (9 pax) and a total bill of 8700 php with drinks, mains and desserts with 10% service charge. 👌🏻 They have private parking for their guests. Food is really delicious and uses high-quality ingredients. Pain au chocolat tastes authentic. Amazing and wide selection from pastries, artisanal coffee, appetizers, filipino and european food. The place is clean, cooled with air conditioning units, stylish interior, toilets are complete with bidet and toilet paper. It was well curated. Joshua and his team deserves recognition. Love the positive vibes they bring. 🫶🏻 Very welcoming and attentive to our needs. Glasses are filled with water whenever empty. The restaurant is only 6 months old, if they can maintain the same high standards, for sure it will be everyone's go to restaurant in Davao.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Gervacios is simply superb. I am a returning customer from Europe and I can 100% vouch for the quality of their croissants, pastries and cakes. They beat anything you will find in the bakeries of the great European capitals. Everything is fresh and made to an incredibly high standard. The atmosphere is always welcoming and warm here. Highly recommend. SPECIAL MENTION GOES TO TEAM MEMBER MARVIN!!!!! I was here in Davao for a 10 day stay almost 7 months ago and had a Latte and croissant most mornings. Marvin recognized me straight away when I returned today and and........... remembered that I drank Latte 👍👍. That would not happen in Europe.or the US. Great work Marvin and Team 👏👏👏👏

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: They listed mozzarella as an ingredient in their green goddess quinoa salad but upon checking the order, they replaced it with parmesan cheese. Service and ambience was good but food was way too low. Don't start me with the Gervacio brownies.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Good food, cozy place. What more can you ask for? Recommend the blueberry danish, truly one of a kind Food was spectacular given its price. Experience dining at a boutique cafe without putting a hole in your bank balance

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Food is superb. There are a lot of choices, so I ordered 3 plus the oreo shake and mango cheesecake. 1. Green Goddess Quinoa Salad- my favorite. It has chicken, and the dressing (avocado celery dressing) is to die for! 2. Salmon Salpicao- wow! Now I understand why it is one of the best sellers. The sourdough is freshly made and the potato wedges… I will be back for those. 3. Longganisa on brioche topped with egg benedict (I forgot the exat name in the menu sa kalami 😋) 4. I haven't tried a mango cheesecake like this. The taste is a good combination of mango and cheese. The cheese is not overpowering. 5. Oreo Drink- super! I haven't tried their coffee yet because I chose this drink over the coffee and fresh fruit mix drinks. I have to-go boxes, perfect for breakfast the next day. The atmosphere is very nice, which is a plus. The place is a good spot for a meet-up.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Exquisite coffee Kouign-amman perhaps one of the best pastries I have ever eaten. It is a triumph, the pinnacle of human achievement. One should go here just for the baked goods alone. Their coffee was good, comparable to other cafes I've been to.The entrees here are hit or miss. The beef tapa I got one breakfast was insanely tough but the other breakfast dish I got was perfect. I really should go back for their Potatoes Dauphinois.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: 📍 Cafe Gervacios, CM Recto, DVO ✅ A fresh addition to Davao's coffee scene ✅ Has an elegant interior that exudes sophistication and warmth ✅ Menu is impressively diverse, catering to various tastes with options ranging from classic coffee and frappe beverages to rice meals and pastries ✅ Parking space is available at the back 💖 Hawaiian Pizza - P285 💖 Gervacios Signature Cheeseburger - Php 390 ❤️ Cookies and Cream Frappe - P175 ❤️ Hot Chocolate - P190 ❤️ Iced Mocha Dream Latte - P195

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Liked the vibe it's giving one time we walked pass by the place hence we visited to grab something to eat. The have a plethora of food options, some good pastries and cakes are also available. The coffee was good and apparently the use a variety of beans, some of which will cost extra. Had iced americano and the caffeine was really giving. The gerry's brownie was delectable with lots of nuts in it. The place feels like an elevated and modern take of american diner. Window blinds and warm lighting is cozy. Some seats are comfortable while some others by the window are much simpler. It is noteworthy to mention though that they charge service charge fees on your total bill

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: ~~~ I chose Cafe Gervacios for my Day 5 post-simbang gabi brekky adventure because it was the nearest to the Jacinto campus. I also love the American diner vibe of its interiors. I know cafe americano is supposed to be taken black. It's the only kind of coffee they have as a freebie for your breakfast. But, I take my coffee with sugar and cream. The brown sugar was free. Not the creamer. I had to pay for it. 😆 I ordered honey glazed chicken and waffles, and garlic rice to go with it. Pinoy po ako, kailangang may kanin. 😉🇵🇭 I loved the salad on the side, especially its dressing - balsamic vinaigrette. The salad was gone in sixty seconds. Really. The chicken fillet was fried to perfection. And that chicken dip, magnifico. 🤤 The waffles and the maple syrup were a nice meal ender. But, I didn't want it to end. 🤪 So, I ordered Ferrero to cap my breakfast off. It looked scrumptiously inviting. It was also messy to eat. 🤣 I enjoyed it. I stayed for over two hours. It was relaxing. I think I was the only customer who dined in from 6 AM to past 8AM. There were three other tables occupied by the time I left. (I fondly remember my mom. God bless her soul. She and I kind of have that 'magnet' effect when we go to restaurants. She was the the first who noticed it.) As always, I appreciate good music, which Cafe Gervacios have. ❤️🎵❤️ Pretty good taste, too. 😉 This was my third visit. The first was for dinner with high school friends. The second was for lunch - alone, as usual. Looking forward to my fourth visit. Thanks to the staff for their very warm thank you when I left, and that special "Ingat po." 🫰 I wonder where Day 6 will take me. 🤔

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Food and pastries are so good! Me and my friends loved it here. We were looking for a good cafe around downtown and we found this very cute place. The food and place 10/10!

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: A we'll designed place. Has a cozy and chill vibe, the food was delicious I loved their matcha and pastry its really mouth watering .. will visit this again

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: This is by far the friendliest establishment I have walked into in PH. From the guard at the door, to each and every staff member, the service was great. Downside, like most places, don't have a single veg/vegan item I could have with my coffee. I suggested to the person who took my order, to feedback to the chef that 1or2 vegan items would be well accepted. The Spanish latte I had was v nice and again they accommodated for me re sweetness. One of owners, Shirley, made the effort to come to my table when she heard about my dietary restrictions. She was lovely and also said she would discuss with her brother-in-law (chef) regarding introducing some items. Family run business and a 5-star experience.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Standing along the old downtown street of CM Recto, you can drive past this place during the day without even noticing it. Opens early at 9 a.m. The fair list of food offerings and a parking lot behind makes it a fitting place for small get-togethers….The Crisp Apple Salad was more on apple slices thrown in and just few lettuce leaves…The Chicken Pesto Penne with Mozzarella Pearls was just amply prepped for one person… Sweet Nostalgia Latte, I truly liked….The Creamy Spinach pizza to share tasted okay but had thick burnt edges… No need to meditate over when you are in this central part of the city… Snack items like a line of pastries in full view — have a go at their croissants… Be prepared for the spacious parking ground that's stony, uneven and can get muddy at times…

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Finally, a luxury cafe along CM Recto! Cafe Gervacios brings a classic retro vibe infused with modern design and signature dishes. This bakery cafe offers some of the best croissants and pastries in Davao! Make sure to try their Sourdough Croissant, Basque Burnt Cheesecake, and Coffee Kouign-Amann. Pair it up with a fresh cup of coffee -- hot or iced, depending on your liking. In addition, Cafe Gervacios offers unique dishes to fill the tummy. We enjoyed Gerry's Signature Homemade Longganisa, Ham and Cheese Panini on Sourdough Bread, and Margherita Pizza. We felt comfortable inside their cozy dining area adorned with art-deco style seating and furniture. The place is also big enough for families and workmates.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: The ambience was great. Food was also good, but on the slightly pricy side. But over-all a worthy place to visit.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: I would like to take ALL of their homemade meals in their breakfast menu... ALL of It. The place is very nice, well lit, spacious and feels very comfy. Hard to make a choice on the Menu, everything looks good. From the Appetizers, and Breakfast meals to the Frappes, better make sure to have room for dessert. Will definitely keep coming back...

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Always just have to visit this cafe when I'm in Davao City. Wide selection of bakery items and a nice atmosphere.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Lovely place and decors. Good food with vegetarian options. Parking available at the back

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: We are welcomed by very charming staff , the place was full of vibrant customers , the location was perfect for meet up with friends, we had hot drinks and oatmeal cookie and that same like croisant pastry ( i forget the exact name) though twas dlivered late ,

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: The food and the atmosphere was good. The place is a little bit crowded which is understandable since it is a newly opened café and the good qualities that I mentioned. Sadly, our order (attached photo) TOOK MORE THAN 50 minutes to serve. We were very patient about it because the place was full of customers but I noticed that the 3 groups of customers that came to the café after us were served first. That's when I approached the staff on the counter for the update of our order. We waited and it took about 8 minutes for them to approach us and ask who took our order. I was not able to know the name but I know it's a woman stationed at the counter and I mentioned my name because I know that they wrote it on the OR. They searched for our OR and found out that they misplaced it (it fell on the floor). Thankfully, they found it and confirmed our orders. They served it later on after preparing the coffee and frappe. However, they made a mistake because they served the matcha basque and eclair twice which also meant that they weren't very organized when it comes to their order system. Hopefully this will be addressed in the near future.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: We first visited this coffee place for lunch, and everything was perfect and delicious, which made us come back the next day for breakfast. The croissant was especially delicious. Highly recommended.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Food was good, portions were large, prices are affordable, atmosphere is comfortable, staff were very kind

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Spacious parking, okay food, and great ambience. I especially loved how accommodating the staff were. They also have a great selection of pastries, and I loved the sticky mango rice.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: I appreciate the ambiance, which strikes a perfect balance ,neither too subtle nor too overpowering. It's comfortably inviting. Moreover, the staff are very accommodating.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: The place looks nice, which is why we tried it for breakfast. The servers were unapproachable and unfriendly, and it felt like we had to adjust to their mood rather than being treated as valued customers. Dining shouldn't feel like walking on eggshells. Luckily, the food was good, which made it somewhat bearable. Other customers were rude too, but I won't go into details.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: I was actually the first customer to avail the 125php coffee + sourdough crossiant when it formally opened doors to the public two days ago and of course the spaghetti + meatballs 🍝🍞🇮🇹 is so succulent and delicious as well 😊 as far as the ambiance of Cafe Gervacios' it's cool and good and it's not hard to locate it and it is so similar to the restaurants in downtown Manhattan in New York City 🇺🇸

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Pastries and drinks were so good and affordable! Love the ambience and the staff were so friendly.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Whether you are by yourself, or with someone, Cafe Gervacios is one of the places to visit in Davao City. Feel comfortable in the quality of their service, and be full in the quality of the food they serve.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: What I was able to try when we went there to pick up an order was their Iced Spanish Latte. I love that their coffee was not "sour" and the sweetness of the drink was just enough not to overpower the whole drink. They also had a bit of a free taste of their carbonated fruit drink that was made of local fruits which was very good. I am very much looking forward to their opening. Will surely visit again 🫶🏽

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Giving it five stars because their pastries are great, the crew are consistently polite and the vibe is the right kind of cozy. Though I'd suggest to include brewed coffee in the menu and a variety of coffee blend that mix arabica & robusta (was informed by the server both blends you have are 100% arabica). Fridays & Saturdays, they close at 11pm.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Croissants are aesthetically pleasing and flavorful. Truly quality croissants. Fluffy, moist, and, of course, masarap. 💚 Love the packaging and heating instruction, talagang pinag-isipan to offer quality food and service. I also like the Iced Americano, and I love na hindi sya acidic tasting, and you can sense the aroma of newly brewed coffee. 😊 Worth trying and balik-balikan. 😊✌

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: The place is great, very aesthetic. The food is good but I think it's too pricey for its quality.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: My happy place, big-brain time space when in Davao. Best flat white, reminds me of Wellington, NZ. I love everything that I ordered. I will return and linger for sure.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Really good food and friendly staff. Amazing ambience. Would be back regularly. They have new products and I'm back regularly jud.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Great food and service, definitely recommended.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Ordered the Caesar salad specifically because it did not have pork. When I received the salad, it was covered in bacon pieces. I informed the waitress about this and she apologized and the kitchen remade my salad. But the bizarre thing is that after questioning the employees, it seems this is a normal practice (putting bacon on the salads). The menu clearly states what is in the salad, but it does not mention anything about pork (see picture that I've attached). Management has two ways of dealing with this: Option 1: update your menus so they are accurate. Option 2: follow the actual recipes described in the menu so people get what they order. Other than that, service was professional and excellent, food was delicious, location was convenient, and atmosphere was perfect. It would have been five stars otherwise. But because of the incorrect menu, I can only give it three stars. Also note, the restaurant is quite expensive. Don't come here if you're trying to save money. But it is high quality.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Very tasty coffee, but unfortunately one of the worst salads I've ever had: it was dirty and not sorted well - see picture

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: They have the best Spanish latte and kouign-amann! Always coming back to this café and bakery.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: The place was great! The interior and the staffs hospitality is top notch! The beef ragu pasta, however, was bland or just my taste (for the price, I expected more).. still, loved the sourdough croissant and their margarita pizza! Loved the drinks too! Overall, a nice place for a date!

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Nice Ambiance, Very Relaxing. Food taste is average. But overall is Good and would love to comeback❤

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: My mom loves the atmosphere of this place. It reminded her of the old Meralco along Ilustre but new, making it a perfect spot for friends and family to gather. Because it's relatively new, the food menu is somewhat limited (or so I rationalised to myself), but it's a fusion of Italian and Pinoy, and the portions are generous. Their beverage menu is more than adequate, and you have a lot to choose from the creative drinks they've come up with. We love the sour dough croissant; recommend it! The staff are super responsive and friendly even during peak hours; never breaking a sweat. It opens till late around 10 and one of the few cafes along Claveria.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City

review_text: A wonderful café that's definitely worth visiting! The croissants are a little pricey, but they're worth every peso. The quality and flavor are outstanding. The owner is very friendly, and the staff are welcoming and attentive. Don't miss the Tiramisu Croissant—it was my favorite! Their coffee was also excellent, especially the one with chocolate and blueberry flavor notes. Great food, great coffee, and great service. I'll definitely be back!

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: food: i loved their hot choco! and croissant/pastries. presentation is also very good. update: they are also offering matcha drinks. matcha latte and ube matcha are so good. service: staff are very accommodating! they prepare the table and offer water without us waiting too long. even the cashier helped in the service. looks like they are trained for fine dining service. atmosphere: not crowded and have plenty of seats.can be crowded during peak days (like Saturday or Sunday). ambiance is good.

review_text: Our go to restaurant, priced right for the food, pastries are very good, just wish they have a hi chair for kids

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Great selection of pastries and bread! The staff were very warm, welcoming, and accommodating. I stopped by to buy some croissants for takeout, and they even offered me a glass of water, asking whether I preferred it hot or cold. It was a simple gesture, but it made the experience feel genuinely thoughtful. Kudos to the management and staff for providing excellent customer service. It really shows that the team is well-trained. Keep up the great work! 👏🥐

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: Super loved their food! My fiancé and I ordered the Homemade Beef Tapa and the House Smoked Bacon all-day breakfast meals, and both were absolutely delicious. Everything was well-seasoned, satisfying, and definitely worth trying. We'll definitely be coming back! We also tried their coffee, and it was really good. If I remember correctly, it was called Sweet Nostalgia. It had just the right amount of sweetness—subtle and well-balanced, making it enjoyable without being overpowering or too sweet.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: I ordered takeout around 11:40, and unfortunately the bread tasted stale. Even after following the reheating instructions, it still had the texture and flavor of bread that was several days old. It was quite disappointing, especially since I was looking forward to it. I hope this was just an isolated incident because the freshness of the bread makes a big difference.

review_text: The food are delicious. The cake and coffee were awesome.. Just a little bit expensive compared to other Resto.

review_text: The muffin was bland huhu spanish latte was overly bitter. Nice ambiance tho.

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: One of the best cafes I've been to this 2024, and I mean it since I've been all around trying different cafes at different countries and local tourist spots this year as well. The whole concept was nicely done, pastries and ala carte meals were delicious. Coffee was decent. Staffs were attentive and helpful. I'll definitely come back if ever I go on a vacation in Davao again, will definitely take my family with me next time. 😁

place_name: Cafe Gervacios - Pastry and Coffee in Davao City
review_text: I went for a late lunch. There were a lot of people, so it looked like we wouldn't be able to get in right away, but they checked and let us in immediately. The food was delicious; everything was tasty. I would like to go again if I have the chance.
